# Bye Bye Chunk By Boltr

__Bye Bye Chunk__ is a server-side Fabric mod that deletes chunks after players leave them.

When chunk deletion is enabled, the mod tracks player movement between chunks. Once a player exits a chunk, that chunk is scheduled for deletion and gradually replaced with air. This creates a challenge where the world disappears behind you, making backtracking dangerous or impossible.

## Features
- Deletes chunks after players leave them
- Server-side gameplay logic
- Works through commands using /byebyechunk
- Global enable/disable toggle
- Per-player control
- Adjustable deletion speed
- Adjustable deletion delay
- Multiplayer safety toggle
- Spawn chunk safety toggle
- Warning message toggle
- Queue management commands
- Config file support
- Starts disabled by default for safety

![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b522cf7315addecf11875549c112d28a0010938b.webp)

## Server-Side Mod

This mod is designed to run on the server. The chunk deletion logic is handled server-side, meaning players connecting to a server do not need to control the deletion behavior themselves.

For singleplayer, the mod still works normally because singleplayer worlds run an integrated server.

## Safety Notice

This mod is intentionally destructive. Deleted chunks are replaced with air and the changes are saved to the world.

Do not test this mod on a world you care about unless you have a backup.

By default, chunk deletion starts _OFF_ and must be manually enabled with:

/byebyechunk on

## Main Commands
    /chunkbyebye status  
    /chunkbyebye on  
    /chunkbyebye off  
    /chunkbyebye speed <layers>  
    /chunkbyebye delay <ticks>  
    /chunkbyebye warnings on|off  
    /chunkbyebye multiplayer_safety on|off  
    /chunkbyebye spawnchunk_safety on|off  
    /chunkbyebye queue status  
    /chunkbyebye queue clear  
    /chunkbyebye everyone  
    /chunkbyebye only <player>  
    /chunkbyebye player <player> on|off|status  

Only high-level server operators can use the mod commands.

## Intended Use

Bye Bye Chunk is designed for Minecraft challenge videos, custom survival scenarios, multiplayer chaos, and experimental gameplay where the world slowly disappears as players explore.
